column4: Bit weepy today. Fed up of being stuck indoors but I know it'll pass.
How long does it usually take to sleep properly again after a joint replacement?
Not getting sleep in night, only 4-5 hours. Can I take sleeping tablet? Kindly advise.
cant get comfy at nite, keep waking every 2 hrs. tips?
Sleeping on my back is so hard. Any tricks for getting comfortable with a new hip?
My dad is quite grumpy and low since the operation. He's eating and doing his exercises. Is that normal?
Feeling down some days but not hopeless, nothing like that. Just bored. Ideas to keep busy?
I haven't slept more than a couple of hours a night all week, I'm barely eating and I cry most of the day. I'm just not coping.
Mum has hardly eaten or slept for five days, won't get out of bed and just stares at the TV. She says she's fine but she isn't.
From one week I am not sleeping, not eating, feeling very very low and crying. Family is worried. What to do?
Ten days now of feeling flat and anxious all the time, panicky at night, can't eat. The knee's fine, it's me that isn't.
honestly not coping, havent slept properly in 4 nights, havent showered, cant face anything
Some nights I think everyone would be better off without me. I've been looking at my tablets and thinking about it.
I am feeling there is no point to live now. I am only burden on my children. Sometimes I think to end it.
My husband told me tonight he doesn't want to wake up any more. He's never said anything like that before. He's 3 weeks after his hip.
I keep having thoughts about hurting myself. I don't want to feel like this.
Is it normal to feel nervous about going out on my own after surgery?
Can the painkillers affect my mood?
Feeling irritated on small small things after operation. Is it due to medicines? Otherwise all fine.
I had a wobble last week and felt really low, but talking to my sister helped and I'm sleeping again now.
Do the vivid dreams from the opioids stop when I come off them?
Frustrated I still need help with my socks. Silly thing to get upset about.
My wife is worried she'll never walk properly again. How can I reassure her?
Is melatonin ok to take with my other tablets?
feelin a bit down but managing, physio cheers me up lol
What are the signs that post-op low mood is turning into depression, so I know when to ask for help?
Doctor sir, I am getting tension about recovery. Will I walk like before? My daughter's marriage is in 3 months.
Knee aches more at night and wakes me up. Should I time my painkiller for bedtime?
Napping in the afternoon then awake half the night. How do I break the cycle?
Is there someone I can talk to about feeling anxious? Not urgent.
Not suicidal or anything like that, just really fed up and grumpy today. Normal at week 3?
Can I use a heat pad at night to help me drop off?
My mother is getting fear to walk after hip operation, she is scared she will fall again. How to give her confidence?
I keep snapping at my family. Are mood swings after an anaesthetic a thing?
y do i feel so tired all the time, sleeping 10 hrs and still knackered
Had a panic in the night thinking about clots, but my calf is fine and my breathing is normal. How do I stop worrying?
How long before I feel like myself again?
Can I watch TV late night or it will disturb sleep? I am not having any work now so time is not passing.
Lonely in the day while everyone's at work. Phoning friends helps.
Should I keep taking my antidepressant as usual after surgery?
Dad is sleeping much more than usual but he's alert when awake and eating fine. Just recovery?
Had a rough couple of nights but last night I slept 7 hours. Feeling more hopeful.
feeling bore at home whole day, can i go office for half day atleast? mood is getting off
Any relaxation exercises for when I can't switch off at night?
sleep finally improving
A friend said people sometimes feel suicidal after big operations. Is that true, and who would I call if it ever happened?
